scope: Check whether the current host pointer can be mapped to the project MAME window using read-only X11 window metadata, without moving the pointer or sending guest input.
result: The host X11 query did not identify a window belonging to the MAME PID, and host pointer coordinates have no verified transform to the guest snapshot. This does not establish whether MAME is Wayland-native, unmapped, or otherwise absent from this X11 tree. The method cannot confirm that the cursor is over a guest scrollbar arrow.
next: Do not use host X11 coordinates or guessed counter calibration to press a guest arrow. Obtain a current image that visibly correlates the pointer with the MAME guest target, or request the user to position the pointer, before one bounded held/released comparison.
